notes: Found by job-scout; Berlin/Germany remote-friendly; travel 20-40%; also listed Berlin 4418824220 + Frankfurt 4418816639; gaps production scale, ReAct naming, safety evals
apply_hint: Apply via the LinkedIn posting (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4418823251) or the Cohere careers page; the same role is also listed for Berlin and Frankfurt, apply once. Their screening uses AI tools; keep the CV as is.
verdict: Close match on the core: LLM-powered agents with tools and orchestration (LangGraph multi-agent system), RAG, systematic evaluation against ground truth, Python, end-to-end ownership as sole developer, and customer-facing translation of ambiguous needs (Covestro AI consulting). Gaps: "production-grade" enterprise deployments at scale, named agent patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute), latency/safety evaluation, enterprise security/compliance, and this is a senior-leaning role ("lead the design", "set architectural standards").

form_fields.label: Why Cohere?
form_fields.value: North runs agents close to sensitive enterprise data, even air-gapped, for customers like RBC and Dell; I want to build agents that are measured and checked by the people who use them, directly with customers.

form_fields.label: Salary expectation
form_fields.value: €70,000 gross/year (range €60,000–75,000). Must be above the EU Blue Card threshold.

form_fields.label: Location
form_fields.value: Berlin, remote within Germany is fine; travel 20–40% fine.

questions.q: Design an agent for an enterprise workflow and tell us how you'd evaluate it.
questions.a: Frame the task, define success criteria with the customer, build a labelled set, measure accuracy and latency, add human approval where risk is high. Evidence: Kniit ground-truth loop (33/45 → 93/90), Expert Interface approvals.

questions.q: Explain your agent architecture in ReAct or Plan-and-Execute terms.
questions.a: Kniit: parallel specialist agents + consolidation + reflection (plan/critique loop); Covestro: router agent choosing tools (vector search, inference, summarization).

questions.q: Tell us about working with a customer on an ambiguous problem.
questions.a: Covestro AI consulting: mapped decision workflows with business stakeholders, advised where agentic AI fits, then built it.
